parent:
name: Compile check

# Everyday gate: build the app and run a small, high-value smoke set.
# Exhaustive unit/UI coverage is retained in preproduction-qa.yml.
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: write

on:
  push:
    branches: ["wip/**"]
  # Run on every PR target, including stacked feature/test branches, so a
  # dependent PR cannot silently bypass the compile gate while based on another PR.
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: compile-check-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  changes:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/classify-native-scope.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

  python-tests:
    # One credential-free candidate-head suite. Merge-ref Python duplication in
    # Dogfood is intentionally removed; native Dogfood coverage is unchanged.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Run complete Python script suite once
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v

  docs-validation:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Validate docs IDs and generated checklist consistency
        run: python3 scripts/check-ids.py

  build-nutrition:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
    runs-on: xcode-27
    # Full units/nutrition and later regressions have independent exact-head jobs
    # with separate lower budgets (45m / 110m).
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      ATE_SIGN_STYLE: Automatic
    steps:
      # PR validation must build the exact proposed head, not GitHub's synthetic merge commit.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: "27.1"
      - name: Cache Xcode DerivedData
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData
          key: xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-${{ hashFiles('project.yml', '**/Package.resolved') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-${{ hashFiles('project.yml', '**/Package.resolved') }}-
            xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-
      - name: Validate docs IDs and generated checklist consistency
        run: python3 scripts/check-ids.py
      - name: Cache Homebrew downloads
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew
          key: xcode-27-homebrew-xcodegen-v1
          restore-keys: |
            xcode-27-homebrew-
      - run: brew install xcodegen && xcodegen generate
      - name: Build isolated App Clip target
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcodebuild build -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme AteClip -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > app-clip-build.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 12 -E "error:|failed|Testing failed" app-clip-build.log || true; tail -100 app-clip-build.log; exit 1; }
          grep -E "BUILD SUCCEEDED|warning:" app-clip-build.log | tail -30
      - name: Run App Clip URL contract tests
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          SIM_ID=$(python3 scripts/select-ios-simulator.py)
          xcodebuild test -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme AteClip -destination "id=$SIM_ID" -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/app-clip-tests.xcresult" -parallel-testing-enabled NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > app-clip-tests.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 12 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Testing failed|Fatal error" app-clip-tests.log || true; tail -100 app-clip-tests.log; exit 1; }
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed|TEST SUCCEEDED" app-clip-tests.log | tail -40
      - name: Prepare diagnostics directory
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results"
      - name: Build for testing (iOS simulator)
        id: build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          STEP_START=$(date +%s)
          SIM_ID=$(python3 scripts/select-ios-simulator.py)
          echo "SIM_ID=$SIM_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          set +e
          xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/build.xcresult" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > build.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          set -e
          STEP_END=$(date +%s)
          echo "::notice::CI_TIMING step=build-for-testing duration_seconds=$((STEP_END-STEP_START)) exit_code=$status"

          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Simulator build failed (xcodebuild exit $status). Matching diagnostics and recent log follow:"
            grep -n -B 8 -A 12 -E "error:|warning:|failed|Fatal error|Testing failed" build.log || true
            echo "::group::Last 100 build log lines"
            tail -n 100 build.log
            echo "::endgroup::"
            exit "$status"
          fi

          grep -E "warning: .*(Widgets|Intents|Snapshot)" build.log > build-warnings.log || true
          tail -n 30 build-warnings.log || true
      - name: Full exact-head unit suite (all AteTests)
        id: unit_tests
        if: ${{ steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          echo "Full unit suite source: $(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          python3 scripts/cook_entry_sample.py --log full-unit-tests.log --simulator "$SIM_ID" --output cook-entry-sample -- \
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteTests \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/full-unit-tests.xcresult" \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 480 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > full-unit-tests.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" full-unit-tests.log || true; tail -120 full-unit-tests.log; exit 1; }
          total=$(sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*Executed ([0-9]+) tests?,.*/\1/p' full-unit-tests.log | tail -1)
          if ! [[ "$total" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$total" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Full AteTests suite reported no execution: ${total:-missing}"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Structured results preserve exact named passes when app stderr splits console rows.
          xcrun xcresulttool get test-results tests --path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/full-unit-tests.xcresult" > full-unit-tests.json
          python3 scripts/verify-full-unit-required.py full-unit-tests.json scripts/full-unit-required.txt
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed|TEST SUCCEEDED" full-unit-tests.log | tail -60

      - name: Retain full unit diagnostics before UI acceptance
        if: always() && (steps.unit_tests.outcome == 'success' || steps.unit_tests.outcome == 'failure')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: full-unit-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            full-unit-tests.log
            cook-entry-sample
            full-unit-tests.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/full-unit-tests.xcresult

      # Keep normal-size audits required; retain cross-size cases in the optional lane.
      - name: Nutrition diary and goals UI regressions (#179)
        if: ${{ always() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          # Clean process so launch arguments are real (same rationale as other UI shards).
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          mkdir -p cookplan-process-lifecycle
          python3 scripts/capture-cookplan-process-lifecycle.py --sim-id "$SIM_ID" --output cookplan-process-lifecycle > cookplan-process-lifecycle/collector-status.txt 2>&1 &
          lifecycle_pid=$!
          stop_lifecycle() {
            kill "$lifecycle_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
            wait "$lifecycle_pid" || true
          }
          trap stop_lifecycle EXIT
          NSUnbufferedIO=YES python3 scripts/ui_query_samples.py --log nutrition-ui-tests.log --simulator "$SIM_ID" --output cook-plan-cancel-live-query -- \
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/NutritionDiaryUITests \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/NutritionGoalsUITests \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CookPlanUITests \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/AccessibilityAuditUITests/testAuditNutritionScreensWithoutDynamicType \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-tests.xcresult" \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 480 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 2>&1 | python3 -u scripts/stream-ui-test-progress.py --selection nutrition-ui --log nutrition-ui-tests.log || status=$?
          stop_lifecycle
          trap - EXIT
          # Export screenshots, hierarchy snapshots and audit attachments on every outcome,
          # including successful runs, so merge-gate pixel evidence is retained.
          xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-tests.xcresult" --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-attachments" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "${status:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
            grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" nutrition-ui-tests.log || true
            tail -120 nutrition-ui-tests.log
            exit 1
          fi
          # Execution evidence: a green selection that ran nothing is a failure, and every
          # named test must appear with its own pass line in the log.
          if grep -q "Executed 0 tests" nutrition-ui-tests.log; then echo "::error::nutrition UI selection executed 0 tests"; exit 1; fi
          for evidence in \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testFoodDiaryOpensAndExplicitlyLogsFoodWithUnavailableValues]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testDiaryShowsGoalPromptWhenGoalsUnconfiguredAndEmptyState]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testLogFoodRejectsNonPositiveQuantityWithVisibleError]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testLogFoodSurfacesSaveFailure]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testCorruptDiaryShowsErrorAndRecoversAfterBackupReset]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testCorruptGoalsShowLoadErrorWithRetry]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testRecipeNutritionShowsIncompleteStateForUnmappedIngredient]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testLoggedEntryCanBeEditedAndShowsUpdatedValues]' passed" \
            "CookPlanUITests testSavedRecipePlanWithoutReminderCanBeReopenedAndCancelled]' passed" \
            "NutritionGoalsUITests testGoalsCanBeConfiguredAndClearedFromSettings]' passed" \
            "NutritionDiaryUITests testThisWeekSectionShowsTotalsForLoggedEntries]' passed" \
            "AccessibilityAuditUITests testAuditNutritionScreensWithoutDynamicType]' passed"; do
            grep -qF "$evidence" nutrition-ui-tests.log || { echo "::error::missing pass evidence: $evidence"; tail -60 nutrition-ui-tests.log; exit 1; }
          done
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed" nutrition-ui-tests.log | tail -80

      - name: Retain selected Nutrition startup liveness
        if: always()
        run: |
          mkdir -p nutrition-startup-liveness
          date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > nutrition-startup-liveness/copy-utc.txt
          if data_container=$(xcrun simctl get_app_container "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate data 2> nutrition-startup-liveness/container-errors.txt); then
            found=0
            for evidence in "$data_container"/Library/Caches/startup-liveness-*.txt; do
              if [ -f "$evidence" ]; then
                cp "$evidence" nutrition-startup-liveness/
                found=1
              fi
            done
            if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
              echo 'No startup samples retained; liveness unverified.' > nutrition-startup-liveness/missing.txt
            fi
          fi

      - name: Retain CookPlan cancel phase ledger
        if: always()
        run: |
          # The app writes COOK-PLAN-CANCEL phase marks to stdout, which never reaches
          # exported diagnostics; the on-device ledger in the app container does. Copy it
          # into the already-exported live-query directory so the phase chain survives.
          mkdir -p cook-plan-cancel-live-query
          if data_container=$(xcrun simctl get_app_container "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate data 2> cook-plan-cancel-live-query/ledger-container-errors.txt); then
            ledger="$data_container/Library/Caches/cookplan-cancel-ledger.txt"
            if [ -f "$ledger" ]; then
              cp "$ledger" cook-plan-cancel-live-query/cookplan-cancel-ledger.txt
            else
              echo 'No cancel phase ledger retained; marks unexported.' > cook-plan-cancel-live-query/ledger-missing.txt
            fi
          fi

      - name: Upload nutrition UI diagnostics (early)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          # Unique per run+attempt and distinct from the tail artifact, so this early upload
          # never collides with the immutable tail artifact name and nutrition diagnostics
          # survive even when a later push supersedes this run before the job tail.
          name: nutrition-ui-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            nutrition-ui-tests.log
            cookplan-process-lifecycle
            cook-plan-cancel-live-query
            nutrition-startup-liveness
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-tests.xcresult
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-attachments

      - name: Upload build and nutrition diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: compile-build-nutrition-diagnostics-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            build.log
            app-clip-build.log
            app-clip-tests.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/app-clip-tests.xcresult
            build-warnings.log
            test.log
            test-summary.log
            ui.log
            ui-summary.log
            production-channel-production.log
            settings-sync.log
            tracker-ui.log
            cook-mode-history.log
            navigation-header-tests.log
            share-publish-outage-tests.log
            nutrition-ui-tests.log
            cookplan-process-lifecycle
            nutrition-startup-liveness
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/*.xcresult
            cook-ingredients-tests.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/cook-ingredients-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/shopping-sync-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/explore-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/cook-finish-accessory-attachments

  regression-suites:
    name: regression suite (${{ matrix.suite }})
    # Separate standard hosted VMs; one simulator and sequential tests per worker.
    # Two regression workers plus nutrition, Journal and Dogfood permit five
    # priority native jobs per head. GitHub's account-wide macOS cap still
    # queues these alongside other PRs; this matrix reserves no extra capacity.
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 110
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:
        include:
          - suite: presentation-creation
            required_logs: insights-evidence-navigation.log share-publish-outage-tests.log interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.log transient-generation-retry.log expandable-recipe-sheet-tests.log
          - suite: account-cooking
            required_logs: settings-sync.log production-channel-production.log settings-about-145.log account-switch-sync-failure-library.log tracker-ui.log navigation-header-tests.log cook-mode-history.log cook-ingredients-tests.log
    env:
      ATE_SIGN_STYLE: Automatic
    steps:
      # PR validation must build the exact proposed head, not GitHub's synthetic merge commit.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: "27.1"
      - name: Cache Xcode DerivedData
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData
          key: xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-${{ hashFiles('project.yml', '**/Package.resolved') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-${{ hashFiles('project.yml', '**/Package.resolved') }}-
            xcode-27-xcode-deriveddata-
      - name: Validate docs IDs and generated checklist consistency
        run: python3 scripts/check-ids.py
      - name: Cache Homebrew downloads
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/Library/Caches/Homebrew
          key: xcode-27-homebrew-xcodegen-v1
          restore-keys: |
            xcode-27-homebrew-
      - run: brew install xcodegen && xcodegen generate
      - name: Prepare diagnostics directory
        run: mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results"
      - name: Build for testing (iOS simulator)
        id: build
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          STEP_START=$(date +%s)
          SIM_ID=$(python3 scripts/select-ios-simulator.py)
          echo "SIM_ID=$SIM_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

          set +e
          xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/build.xcresult" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > build.log 2>&1
          status=$?
          set -e
          STEP_END=$(date +%s)
          echo "::notice::CI_TIMING step=build-for-testing duration_seconds=$((STEP_END-STEP_START)) exit_code=$status"

          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Simulator build failed (xcodebuild exit $status). Matching diagnostics and recent log follow:"
            grep -n -B 8 -A 12 -E "error:|warning:|failed|Fatal error|Testing failed" build.log || true
            echo "::group::Last 100 build log lines"
            tail -n 100 build.log
            echo "::endgroup::"
            exit "$status"
          fi

          grep -E "warning: .*(Widgets|Intents|Snapshot)" build.log > build-warnings.log || true
          tail -n 30 build-warnings.log || true
      # Removed obsolete Library Explore sheet selectors: the tests and UI no longer
      # exist and v9 executed zero tests. Current Journal hub navigation is asserted
      # by InsightsAcceptanceUITests below, not represented as sheet coverage.
      - name: Insights evidence and contextual navigation acceptance (issue #195)
        id: insights_acceptance
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (!cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success') }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testWeeklyCookingInsightShowsEvidenceAndNavigatesToTracker \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testInsightCanBeResolvedAndStaysSuppressedAfterRefresh \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testOpeningCookingHistoryKeepsInsightUntilExplicitDismissal \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testJournalRootReflectionPlacementDraftAndSaveWithoutHealth \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testJournalRootReflectionFailedSaveKeepsDraftVisible \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testCandidateCardsScrollSideBySideWithoutDismissing \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testJournalRootReflectionLabelsSampleHealthPrompts \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testSeededShoppingInsightOpensRealListAndRetainsSuggestion \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testSeededDiaryInsightOpensRealDiaryAndRetainsSuggestion \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/InsightsAcceptanceUITests/testExploreOpensNewSuggestionsNotLibraryAndUnavailableAIIsHonest \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CookReflectionUITests/testSavedCookNoteAppearsUnderRecipeOnCookedDayAtNormalText \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/insights-evidence-navigation.xcresult" \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 480 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > insights-evidence-navigation.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" insights-evidence-navigation.log || true; tail -120 insights-evidence-navigation.log; exit 1; }
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed|TEST SUCCEEDED" insights-evidence-navigation.log | tail -40

      - name: Retain Insights normal-size captures
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (always() && steps.insights_acceptance.outcome != 'skipped') }}
        run: |
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/insights-evidence-navigation.xcresult" ]; then
            xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/insights-evidence-navigation.xcresult" \
              --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/insights-evidence-navigation-attachments" \
              || { echo '::warning::Insights attachment export unavailable; inspect retained xcresult, no pixel acceptance'; }
          fi

      - name: Retain UI-test day-sheet presentation trace
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (always() && steps.insights_acceptance.outcome != 'skipped') }}
        run: |
          xcrun simctl spawn "$SIM_ID" log show --style compact --last 30m \
            --predicate 'subsystem == "com.melusik.ate" AND category == "day-sheet-presentation"' \
            > day-sheet-presentation.log 2>&1 || true

      - name: Share publish outage fallback UI regression (PR #122)
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (!cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success') }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/share-publish-outage-fallback.xcresult" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CoverageUITests/test39_SharePublishOutageFallsBackToTextAndKeepsLibrary \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 180 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 240 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > share-publish-outage-tests.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" share-publish-outage-tests.log || true; tail -100 share-publish-outage-tests.log; exit 1; }
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed|TEST SUCCEEDED" share-publish-outage-tests.log | tail -40

      - name: Interrupted generation Retry lifecycle acceptance (#143)
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (!cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success') }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CoverageUITests/test37_KilledMidGenerationRecovers \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.xcresult" \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 480 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO > interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.log 2>&1 || { grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.log || true; tail -120 interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.log; exit 1; }
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed|TEST SUCCEEDED" interrupted-generation-retry-lifecycle.log | tail -40

      # Unit selectors, including #89 fixtures, execute once in the strict full unit lane.
      - name: Transient generation Retry recovery (#89)
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && (always() && steps.build.outcome == 'success') }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CoverageUITests/test36b_RecipeGenerationRetryRecoversAfterTransientFailure \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/DraftQualityRepairUITests \

            grep -qF "$test]' passed" cook-finish-accessory.log || { echo "::error::Missing named shared-state/detail-overlap pass: $test"; exit 1; }
          done
      - name: Retain Cook Finish accessory captures
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'account-cooking' && always() }}
        run: |
          if [ -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-finish-accessory.xcresult" ]; then
            xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-finish-accessory.xcresult" \
              --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-finish-accessory-attachments"
          fi

      - name: Cook Mode ingredient sheet (UI; session units in full unit lane)
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'account-cooking' && (always() && steps.build.outcome == 'success') }}
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          # Clean process so launch arguments are real (same rationale as other UI shards).
          xcrun simctl terminate "$SIM_ID" com.melusik.ate >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          set +e
          NSUnbufferedIO=YES xcodebuild test-without-building -project Ate.xcodeproj -scheme Ate -destination "id=$SIM_ID" \
            -only-testing:AteUITests/CookIngredientsUITests \
            -skip-testing:AteUITests/CookIngredientsUITests/testCookIngredientSheetLargeTextAccessibilityAndImperial \
            -skip-testing:AteUITests/CookIngredientsUITests/testCookTimerCardLargeText \
            -resultBundlePath "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-ingredients-tests.xcresult" \
            -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES \
            -default-test-execution-time-allowance 240 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 480 \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 2>&1 | python3 -u scripts/stream-ui-test-progress.py --selection cook-ingredients --log cook-ingredients-tests.log
          status=$?
          set -e
          # Export screenshots and attachments on green runs too: for this feature the rendered
          # sheet is itself the evidence, not only failure diagnostics (keepAlways shots).
          xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-ingredients-tests.xcresult" --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/ate-test-results/cook-ingredients-attachments" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            grep -n -B 8 -A 15 -E "error:|failed|XCTAssert|Assertion Failure|Test Case .* failed|Fatal error|Testing failed|Assertion failed" cook-ingredients-tests.log || true
            tail -120 cook-ingredients-tests.log
            exit "$status"
          fi
          # Execution evidence: a green selection that ran nothing is a failure, and every
          # named test must appear with its own pass line in the log.
          if grep -q "Executed 0 tests" cook-ingredients-tests.log; then echo "::error::cook ingredient selection executed 0 tests"; exit 1; fi
          for evidence in \
            "CookIngredientsUITests testCookIngredientSheetScalesChecksAndPersists]' passed" \
            "CookIngredientsUITests testCookIngredientSheetNormalTextAccessibilityAndImperial]' passed" \
            "CookIngredientsUITests testCookTimerCardNormalText]' passed"; do
            grep -qF "$evidence" cook-ingredients-tests.log || { echo "::error::missing pass evidence: $evidence"; tail -60 cook-ingredients-tests.log; exit 1; }
          done
          grep -E "Test Case .* (passed|failed)|Executed" cook-ingredients-tests.log | tail -40

      - name: Require retained regression logs
        if: ${{ always() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          REQUIRED_REGRESSION_LOGS: ${{ matrix.required_logs }}
        run: |
          missing=0
          for log in $REQUIRED_REGRESSION_LOGS; do
            if [ ! -s "$log" ]; then
              echo "::error::Missing regression execution log: $log (not a pass)"
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Summarize regression enforcement
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Regression enforcement"
            echo "- Individual regression command exit codes determine worker success; log text does not override them."
            echo "- All AteTests, including the former #89 focused fixtures, are required in the separate full unit lane."
            echo "- Existing #76 Settings/account-sync quarantine remains advisory; production-channel hiding is blocking."
            echo "- Existing beta-channel UI skip remains quarantined, never a pass."
            echo "- See individual step outcomes and retained logs/xcresults for actual execution evidence."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Link regression failures to owning issues
        if: always()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          # Advisory issue reporting only; these anchored records never decide the gate.
          failure_record_re="^Test Case '-\[.+\]' failed \([0-9.]+ seconds\)\.$|^[[:space:]]*Executed [0-9]+ tests?, with [1-9][0-9]* failures?([[:space:](,]|$)|^\*\* TEST (EXECUTE )?FAILED \*\*[[:space:]]*$|^Testing failed:$"
          report_failure() {
            log_file="$1"; suite="$2"; issue="$3"
            [ -f "$log_file" ] || return 0
            if ! grep -Eq "$failure_record_re" "$log_file"; then return 0; fi
            marker="<!-- ate-ci-regression:${GITHUB_RUN_ID}:${log_file} -->"
            details=$(grep -n -E "$failure_record_re" "$log_file" | tail -n 12 | cut -c1-500 || true)
            [ -n "$details" ] || details="Failure markers found; inspect the full retained log and xcresult."
            run_url="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
            if [ "$issue" = "auto" ]; then
              existing=$(gh issue list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --search "CI regression: $suite in:title" --json number,title --jq '.[0].number // empty')
              if [ -n "$existing" ]; then issue="$existing"; else
                created=$(gh issue create --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "CI regression: $suite" --body "Automated regression report for candidate ${GITHUB_SHA}.\n\nWorkflow run/artifacts: $run_url\nLog: $log_file\n\nFailure evidence:\n\n$details\n\nTriage: reproduce on the exact SHA, add reproduction steps, and verify a fix. This issue is generated from CI evidence and still needs owner/classification.") || { echo "::warning::Could not create backlog issue for $suite"; return 0; }
                issue="${created##*/}"
              fi
            fi
            if [ -z "$issue" ]; then echo "::warning::No issue target resolved for $suite ($log_file)."; return 0; fi
            if gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/$issue/comments?per_page=100" --paginate --jq '.[].body' 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq "$marker"; then echo "Issue #$issue already has this run's regression report."; return 0; fi
            body=$(printf '%s\n' "$marker" "## CI regression detected — NOT PASSED" "- **Suite:** $suite" "- **Candidate SHA:** ${GITHUB_SHA}" "- **Workflow run and retained artifacts:** $run_url" "- **Log:** $log_file" "" "### Failure evidence (tail)" '```text' "$details" '```' "" "### Triage" "Reproduce from the exact candidate SHA, record reproduction steps, and keep this open until a fix is verified. Later diagnostics may still run after a failed step; command failures block except the explicit workflow quarantines. A quarantine is never a pass.")
            if gh issue comment "$issue" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "$body"; then
              echo "::warning::Regression in $suite recorded on issue #$issue (NOT PASSED)."
              echo "- **Issue:** #$issue — $suite" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "- **Evidence:** $run_url" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            else echo "::warning::Could not comment regression evidence for $suite on issue #$issue; run: $run_url"; fi
          }
          report_failure settings-sync.log "Settings/account sync (#76)" 76
          report_failure production-channel-production.log "Production channel UI" auto
          report_failure tracker-ui.log "Cooking Tracker UI (#31)" 31
          report_failure navigation-header-tests.log "Shared navigation header (#68)" 68
          report_failure cook-mode-history.log "Cook Mode completion/history (#31)" 31
          report_failure insights-evidence-navigation.log "Insights evidence and contextual navigation (#195)" 195
      - name: Enforce Insights acceptance result (#195)
        if: ${{ always() && steps.insights_acceptance.outcome == 'failure' }}
        run: |
          echo "::error::Insights acceptance failed. Later diagnostics were allowed to run, but the compile gate remains blocked until issue #195 is fixed."
          exit 1

      - name: Retain expandable return diagnostic attachments
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && always() }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYEXPORT'
          import os, pathlib, subprocess
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
          source = root / 'ate-test-results/expandable-recipe-sheet.xcresult'
          output = root / 'expandable-return-evidence'
          output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
          note = output / 'export-status.txt'
          if not source.is_dir():
              note.write_text('Source xcresult missing; captures unavailable.\n')
          else:
              try:
                  result = subprocess.run(['xcrun', 'xcresulttool', 'export', 'attachments',
                      '--path', str(source), '--output-path', str(output)],
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=60)
                  note.write_text('export_exit=' + str(result.returncode) + '\n' + result.stdout)
                  if result.returncode:
                      print('::warning::Expandable return export failed; see export-status.txt')
              except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                  note.write_text('Export exceeded 60 seconds and was stopped; partial captures may remain.\n')
                  print('::warning::Expandable return export timed out')
              except OSError as error:
                  note.write_text('Export could not start: ' + str(error) + '\n')
                  print('::warning::Expandable return export unavailable')
          PYEXPORT
      - name: Upload expandable return diagnostic attachments
        if: ${{ matrix.suite == 'presentation-creation' && always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: expandable-return-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/expandable-return-evidence
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload test diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: compile-regression-diagnostics-${{ matrix.suite }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            tracker-query-window
            tracker-live-query
            cook-live-query
            cook-completion-window
            coverage-launch-lifecycle
            *.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/draft-quality-repair-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/insights-evidence-navigation-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/library-protein-sheet-attachments
            build.log
            app-clip-build.log
            app-clip-tests.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/app-clip-tests.xcresult
            build-warnings.log
            test.log
            test-summary.log
            ui.log
            ui-summary.log
            production-channel-production.log
            settings-sync.log
            tracker-ui.log
            cook-mode-history.log
            navigation-header-tests.log
            share-publish-outage-tests.log
            nutrition-ui-tests.log
            cookplan-process-lifecycle
            nutrition-startup-liveness
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/nutrition-ui-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/*.xcresult
            cook-ingredients-tests.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/cook-ingredients-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/shopping-sync-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/explore-attachments
            ${{ runner.temp }}/ate-test-results/cook-finish-accessory-attachments

  regressions:
    # Preserve the original required-check context. Matrix skips, cancellation or
    # any failed worker block this aggregate. Regression command failures block;
    # only the explicit #76/beta-channel quarantines above remain advisory.
    needs: [changes, regression-suites]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require every native regression suite
        env:
          REGRESSION_SUITES_RESULT: ${{ needs.regression-suites.result }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REGRESSION_SUITES_RESULT" != success ]; then
            echo "::error::Native regression suites incomplete: $REGRESSION_SUITES_RESULT (not a pass)"
            exit 1
          fi

  compile:
    # Preserve the existing required-check context and fail closed on either lane.
    needs: [changes, python-tests, build-nutrition, regressions]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Require both exact-head native lanes
        env:
          PYTHON_RESULT: ${{ needs.python-tests.result }}
          BUILD_NUTRITION_RESULT: ${{ needs.build-nutrition.result }}
          REGRESSIONS_RESULT: ${{ needs.regressions.result }}
        run: |
          if [ "$PYTHON_RESULT" != success ] || [ "$BUILD_NUTRITION_RESULT" != success ] || [ "$REGRESSIONS_RESULT" != success ]; then
            echo "::error::Native qualification incomplete: python=$PYTHON_RESULT build-nutrition=$BUILD_NUTRITION_RESULT regressions=$REGRESSIONS_RESULT"
            exit 1
          fi

  qualification-result:
    name: Compile qualification result
    if: always()
    needs: [changes, python-tests, compile, docs-validation]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Report actual qualification route
        env:
          PYTHON_RESULT: ${{ needs.python-tests.result }}
          CLASSIFIER: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          NATIVE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.app }}
          NATIVE_RESULT: ${{ needs.compile.result }}
          DOCS_RESULT: ${{ needs.docs-validation.result }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$PYTHON_RESULT" != success ]]; then
            echo 'Python script suite incomplete; qualification is NOT established.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$CLASSIFIER" != success ]]; then
            echo 'Scope classifier failed; qualification is NOT established.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$NATIVE" == false ]]; then
            echo 'Documentation-only diff. Mac compile/tests NOT RUN; this is NOT native qualification.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            [[ "$NATIVE_RESULT" == skipped && "$DOCS_RESULT" == success ]]
          else
            echo "Native qualification required. Mac job result: $NATIVE_RESULT." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            [[ "$NATIVE" == true && "$NATIVE_RESULT" == success ]]
          fi
